scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
other_conditions: The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
A valid rent deed or lease agreement for the shed used for manufacturing activities is required.
The manufacturing activity must consume electricity/power for its operations.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 65% of rent paid, capped at ₹100,000 per annum for up to five years.
documents_required: Acknowledgment or registration certificate from Ministry of MSME or DPIIT
Valid rent deed or lease agreement
